description_en: Creates a topic by calling the CreateTopic operation
description_zh: 调用 CreateTopic 创建 Topic
kebab_example: aliyun alikafka create-topic --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-mp919o4v0000 --topic alikafka_topic_test --remark alikafka_topic_test --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTopic

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.12.774c7dc8F5cWRE#concept-94533-zh) to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
实例 ID。

可调用 GetInstanceList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94533.html?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.12.774c7dc8F5cWRE#concept-94533-zh) 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the topic.

The name can contain only letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
The name must be 3 to 64 characters in length. If the name exceeds 64 characters, it is automatically truncated.
The name cannot be modified after the topic is created
parameters.help_zh:
Topic 的名称。

只能包含字母、数字、下划线（_）和短横线（-）。
长度为 3-64 个字符，多于 64 个字符将被自动截取。
一旦创建后不能再修改
parameters.name: topic

parameters.help_en:
The description of the topic.

The description can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
Topic 的备注。

限制 64 个字符
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en:
The return code.

A value of 200 indicates success
Code.description_zh:
返回码。

返回 200 为成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
